in_hebrew.name: חייש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root חיש (chysh), meaning ‘to fear, to be afraid, to be in terror, to be in a panic.' This name is associated with the fear of the Lord and the awe of His majesty.

in_greek.name: Χαιδέας
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word χαιδέω (chaidéō), meaning ‘to fear, to revere, to have a deep sense of awe.’ This name is associated with the fear of God and the reverence due to His divine nature.

in_latin.name: Hayseus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘hayseus’, derived from the Latin word ‘hayre’, meaning ‘fear, awe, reverence’. This name is associated with the fear of God and the reverence due to His divine nature.
